reviews.title: Works great!
reviews.comment: Works surprisingly good for the price and let's me overclock my ram and CPU easily. I also LOVE gigabyte control center let's me update everything easily
reviews.author: Hayden

reviews.title: Great motherboard, plenty of ports, easy to use bios!
reviews.comment: Very good bios, very well labeled, and theres just the right amount of usb ports. It's smaller than I expected, but that's on me for not doing research and doesn't detract from the rating. The I/O shield is flimsy, but that's okay, and other than that, it's a great motherboard, and survives my clumsy ass very well!
reviews.author: Elliott I.

reviews.title: Gigabyte b650m d3hp
reviews.comment: I received the motherboard in a good packaging and a reasonable time. I tried it with Ryzen 5 7500f + 32 GB lexar rgb ram kit and it is working properly. It only lacks more USB ports and I think it is not for overclocking.
reviews.author: Yasser ElMadany

reviews.title: Incompatible w AMD Ryzen 700 / Fake warranty
reviews.comment: I would not recommend this motherboard with AMD ryzen 700. My bios became unstable and I was left unable to update my motherboard due to risk of freezing during the update. I purchased two motherboard trying to fix this issue and Micro Center is unable to externally update. However, I didn’t find that out until after they already took my money so now I pay over $300 and still have no working motherboard. It says five year warranty in the title, but you will not get your money back.
reviews.author: SpeightWorld LLC

reviews.title: Reliable AM5 Board with Great Features for the Price
reviews.comment:
This motherboard offers solid performance and all the essentials for a modern AM5 build.
Good connectivity, stable operation, and easy BIOS updates.
Excellent value.
reviews.author: Seth
